provenance: Original synthetic cases authored for AUDIT-EXPORT-WARNINGS; no real manuscript.
purpose: One hand-authored corpus read by two independent checkers. warnings is the exact set of unsupported-publication categories the pinned helper reports for the source (tests/differential/renderer.test.ts, through tools/differential/warning_oracle.py). announced, review and exports are checked against Babel's export assessment and export use case (tests/contract/export-assessment.test.ts, tests/contract/export-pdf.test.ts): announced is what the author is told about, in the summary line, in a blocking issue, or as hidden-text syntax inside lines already told about; review says whether export stops for an acknowledgement first; exports says whether a PDF may be published once the renderer returns those warnings. Cases named open finding are real omissions the assessment does not yet report: export stops for them, and each needs a located limitation before exports can become true.
